preprocessing.description: numeric: median imputation (+binary missing indicators for columns with missing values in TRAIN) then standard scaling; categorical: most-frequent imputation then one-hot encoding (handle_unknown='ignore'). Fitted on TRAIN ONLY inside the pipeline; validation/test transformed frozen.

inference.input: pandas.DataFrame with exactly the columns and order in feature_columns.json
inference.output: predicted next-quarter total expenditure in USD (TOTEXPPQ scale, 2004 dollars)

leakage_audit: features available at scoring time only (spending: Phase-3 available-at-t whitelist, chronological split by target file; risk: months -6..-1 + static); preprocessing train-only; no target-derived features (Phase-3/Phase-4 audits)
target_description: Consumer-unit total expenditure (TOTEXPPQ) of the next consecutive interview, trailing-3-month reference window (Phase-3-verified observed target, 20,378 t->t+1 transitions)
output_semantics: predicted next-quarter total expenditure in USD (TOTEXPPQ scale, 2004 dollars)

split.mechanism: chronological by TARGET file (Phase-3 split, unchanged)

cu_past_only_mean.note: defined only where the CU has >=1 prior interview

selection: best supervised model by validation R2 (0.5106); beats the CU past-only mean baseline on both the full test set and the matched subset (Phase-4 report section 12)
caveats: CE 2004 package only (reference quarters 2003Q4-2004Q3); <=4 interviews per CU
unweighted (survey weights excluded as features by rule); not population-representative extrapolation
ITBI dollar income carries a ~1.3-1.5x calibration offset vs income-class bands (Phase-3 caveat D4); relative/temporal uses valid, absolute-dollar income claims need calibration
total_spend_paststd is structurally all-NaN in the train split and is dropped by the train-fitted imputer
